title: Flood Safety
guidelines: Move to higher ground immediately when flood warnings are issued
Never walk, swim, or drive through flood waters — 6 inches of moving water can knock you down
Disconnect electrical appliances before water reaches your home
Keep emergency supplies on the highest floor of your building
After flooding, avoid contact with floodwater — it may be contaminated
Wait for official all-clear before returning to evacuated areas

title: Earthquake Safety
guidelines: DROP, COVER, and HOLD ON — get under sturdy furniture
If outdoors, move to an open area away from buildings and power lines
Do not use elevators during or immediately after an earthquake
Be prepared for aftershocks — they can be stronger than the initial quake
Check for gas leaks — if you smell gas, leave immediately
Keep heavy objects on lower shelves to prevent falling injuries

title: Fire Safety
guidelines: Create a 30-foot defensible space around your home
Close all windows, doors, and vents to prevent ember entry
Wear protective clothing — long sleeves, pants, and N95 mask
Have multiple evacuation routes planned and practiced
Never attempt to outrun a wildfire on foot — use vehicles on clear roads
Keep car fueled and facing the exit direction at all times

title: Cyclone Safety
guidelines: Board up windows and secure outdoor objects before the storm
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor — avoid windows
Fill bathtubs and containers with water for emergency supply
Do not go outside during the eye of the storm — winds will return
Stay away from coastal areas due to storm surge risk
Monitor official weather updates every 30 minutes

title: Medical Emergency
guidelines: Call emergency services immediately — provide exact location
Apply direct pressure to wounds using clean cloth
Do not move injured persons unless they are in immediate danger
Begin CPR if the person is unresponsive and not breathing normally
Keep the person warm and calm until help arrives
Document medications, allergies, and medical conditions for first responders
